conclusion: Byte-exact PT_LOAD materialization is a necessary loader boundary, but it is not evidence that an AQL packet reached the reused GPU pipeline or that any instruction executed.
decision: Keep staging, native translation/AQL construction, queue submission, GPU execution, and user-facing Triton launch as separate gates with separate positive evidence.
invalidated_assumptions: A mapped descriptor and code entry imply that the kernel executed.
A compile-only gfx950 HSACO can satisfy the Triton end-to-end gate.
observation: The CP17 target validates and materializes the pinned image while explicitly reporting aql_submitted=false, kernel_executed=false, and gpu_pipeline_connected=false.
question_or_symptom: Why does a valid mapped gfx950 image still leave Triton end-to-end at 0/1?
